WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT si.healtheval AS status,
         AVG(1.0 * s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate,
         COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS si
    ON CAST(si.zoneregistry AS BLOB) = CAST(s.zoneref AS BLOB)
  GROUP BY si.healtheval
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_of_group_avgs
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_rate) AS avg_status_group_average,
       AVG(g.record_count) AS avg_group_record_count,
       AVG(g.avg_rate - o.avg_of_group_avgs) AS avg_excess_overall
FROM group_stats AS g
JOIN overall_avg AS o
  ON o.avg_of_group_avgs IS NOT NULL
WHERE g.avg_rate > o.avg_of_group_avgs
